title: Zika Virus Disease (CCDD)
description: Chief Complaint and Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) syndrome definition for Zika virus disease, including congenital Zika, querying chief complaint free text and ICD-10/SNOMED CT discharge diagnosis codes.

inclusion_criteria.name: Zika virus disease indicators (chief complaint free text or discharge diagnosis code)

values.description: Excludes chief complaint free text referring to the over-the-counter cold remedy Zicam, which would otherwise falsely match the Zika free-text terms pattern.

notes: Source is a CCDD (Chief Complaint and Discharge Diagnosis) query definition. The original query nests the Zicam exclusion only against the free-text Zika regex match (ANDNOT), not against the entire definition. The Open Syndrome Definition schema does not support a nested ANDNOT operator (only AND/OR/AT_LEAST), so both the Zicam free-text exclusion and the History-of-Zika-virus-infection code exclusion have been modeled as document-level exclusion_criteria (OR'd). This is a simplification of the original query logic.

references.citation: CCDD Category List, Syndromic Surveillance Knowledge Repository

human_readable_definition:
The CCDD parsed field is used to query the discharge diagnosis codes and chief complaint free text.

Inclusion based on Zika Virus Disease-related chief complaint free text terms:
The visit is included if it contains:
Chief complaints related to Zika virus disease – (“zica”, “zika”, “zyca”, “zyka”, “zici”, “ziki”, “zyci”, “zyki”, “zeeca”, “zeeka”) OR
Chief complaints related to Congenital Zika – (“congenital zica”, “congenital zika”, “congenital zyca”, “congenital zyka”, “congenital zici”, “congenital ziki”, “congenital zyci”, “congenital zyki”) OR
Exclusion based on the chief complaint free-text terms related to Zika virus disease above:
Chief complaint related to the cold remedy Zicam – (“zicam”) OR
Inclusion based on ICD-10 discharge diagnosis codes related to Zika virus:
The visit is included if it contains:
A discharge diagnosis code of Zika virus disease (A92.5) OR
A discharge diagnosis code of Contact with and (suspected) exposure to Zika virus (Z20.821) OR
A discharge diagnosis code of Congenital Zika virus disease (P35.4) OR
Inclusion based on SNOMED CT discharge diagnosis codes related to Zika virus:
The visit is included if it contains:
A discharge diagnosis code of Zika virus (50471002) OR
A discharge diagnosis code of Zika virus disease (3928002) OR
A discharge diagnosis code of Exposure to Zika virus (16468541000119105) OR
A discharge diagnosis code of Congenital infection caused by Zika virus (762725007) ANDNOT
All of the above must exclude:
SNOMED CT code related to History of Zika virus infection (16468501000119108)
